messages.author: 2d9ca635f8ad3259
messages.subject: App frequently "disconnected from server"  - Leaflet map ?
parts:
An app I have developed regularly disconnect from server at different times and in different locations in the app. The app (https://malaria.shinyapps.io/lao_dashboard_beta/):
  • run flawlessly locally
  • the data is taken from two .Rdata files that in total weight less than 800 Kb (including all data frames and shapefiles)
  • the heaviest computation take less than 0.5 sec locally (and possibly less - I haven't measured)
  • hosted on shinyapps.io on a Large (1Gb) instance, 15mn Instance Idle Timeout, 30sec Idle Timeout
What I have tried:
  • look at the logs - nothing unusual apart from some warnings that there are missing values in calls to ggplot()
  • play with performance options as http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/scaling-and-tuning.html
Possible problem:
  • I am working from a country with sometime poor internet connection but the app seems problematic even with a good connection
  • a heavy usage to leaflet maps though there are only very lights shapefiles as layers
  • sometime, trying to modify advance options in my Starter Plan, I receive the message "Error updating settings"

Any help would be greatly appreciated! 

Olivier

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App frequently "disconnected from server" - Leaflet map ?
parts: It looks like you are running out of memory. While calculating the heat maps, it takes a _very_ long time to build them, then it transfers 20+ mb for each one. Once they reach the memory limit, the application is killed, resulting in the disconnect. You could try using a large instance for your application, or investigate why it is consuming so much memory.

It looks like you are running out of memory. While calculating the heat maps, it takes a _very_ long time to build them, then it transfers 20+ mb for each one.
